## Getting help

1. Read [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.qmd) first.
2. Email [office.msicph@iisc.ac.in](mailto:office.msicph@iisc.ac.in).

When you ask, include 3 things:

- your operating system and its version;
- the exact error message, as text rather than a screenshot;
- the output of `sessionInfo()`.

Those 3 things turn a question we cannot answer into one we can.

## After the course

This site stays online. The materials are licensed
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) and the code is MIT,
so you may reuse and adapt them with attribution.

Corrections are welcome. Use the **Report an issue** link at the top right of
any page.
